item.title: [com.blockether/lanterna "3.1.5-vis.64"]
item.description: Patched build of mabe02/lanterna 3.1.5 with PR #625 (emoji rendering in StreamBasedTerminal/AbstractTextGraphics) cherry-picked, plus a port of the opentui width and terminal rules: grapheme segmentation and cell widths from the opentui Unicode tables with the wcwidth, unicode and unicode-wide methods; TerminalCapabilities detects the method, OSC 66 explicit width and explicit cursor positioning from the environment and the terminal replies (XTVERSION, DECRQM 2027, cursor position probes), and TerminalScreen draws graphemes as opentui does; control chars degrade to a space instead of throwing. Adds com.googlecode.lanterna.terminal.image.TerminalImage for Kitty/iTerm2 inline graphics and com.googlecode.lanterna.terminal.html for complete interactive browser terminals, portable cell-accurate HTML views and embedded image/video/audio media. Superset of com.googlecode.lanterna:lanterna:3.1.5.

item.title: [com.vaelii/sqlite "0.33.0"]
item.description: SQLite targets for vaelii's storage protocols. The first is the snapshot sink (vaelii.sqlite.snapshot): a SnapshotSink / SnapshotSource over a single SQLite file, so a KB image — the index projection today, any of io.snapshot's named sections — lands in a zero-configuration file as a few bulk transactions and reads back the same way. An Apache-2.0 adapter on the SSPL engine, depending on core, never depended on by it.

item.title: [com.vaelii/postgres "0.33.0"]
item.description: Postgres targets for vaelii's storage protocols, in two independent lanes. The record store (vaelii.postgres.record-store) puts a KB's durable ground truth in a database — core selects it as :pg-memory or :pg-disk-log — with COPY on the bulk path, a fetch LRU in front of a round-trip point read, and cursor-streamed enumerations. The snapshot sink (vaelii.postgres.snapshot) is a SnapshotSink / SnapshotSource, so a KB image — the index projection today, any of io.snapshot's named sections — lands in a database as a few bulk transactions and reads back the same way. An Apache-2.0 adapter on the SSPL engine, depending on core, never depended on by it.
